mapper.sql: select c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.author_id, c.reply_to_user_id, c.create_time, ifnull(nullif(trim(u.real_name), ''), u.nick_name) as author_name, nullif(trim(ap.community_nickname), '') as author_community_nickname, u.avatar as author_avatar, ifnull(nullif(trim(ru.real_name), ''), ifnull(ru.nick_name, c.reply_to_user_name)) as reply_to_user_name, nullif(trim(rp.community_nickname), '') as reply_to_community_nickname from qt_forum_comment c left join sys_user u on c.author_id = u.user_id left join qt_member_profile ap on ap.user_id = u.user_id left join sys_user ru on ru.user_id = c.reply_to_user_id left join qt_member_profile rp on rp.user_id = ru.user_id
mapper.select:
and c.post_id = #{postId}
order by c.create_time asc, c.comment_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into qt_forum_comment (post_id, parent_id, content, author_id, reply_to_user_id, reply_to_user_name, create_time) values (#{postId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, #{authorId}, #{replyToUserId}, #{replyToUserName}, now())
